text: The fourteen children and doubles have been accounted for. The court's reaction changes which allies and terms are available; choose a response after weighing the cost.

options.label: Review a bargain that releases one named freed child
options.when: (campaign.var.elf_lord_reaction == 'curious' or campaign.var.elf_lord_reaction == 'bargaining') and (campaign.var.figwort_stance == 'rescue' or campaign.var.village_trust >= 2) and (campaign.var.child_arthur_figwort == 'freed' or campaign.var.child_amelia_goodall == 'freed' or campaign.var.child_bernard_goodall == 'freed' or campaign.var.child_giles_weadley == 'freed' or campaign.var.child_philip_anvil == 'freed' or campaign.var.child_ursula_cooke == 'freed' or campaign.var.child_stevie_leeford == 'freed')

options.label: Review permanent court service or a court stay for the named party
Publish the verified evidence to the village and priory
options.when: (campaign.var.evidence_brugh_layout or campaign.var.evidence_gold_threads or campaign.var.evidence_arthur_double or campaign.var.evidence_fairy_mirrors or campaign.var.evidence_parent_suspicion) and (campaign.var.figwort_stance == 'protect' or campaign.var.figwort_stance == 'reconcile' or campaign.var.village_trust >= 1)

options.label: Protect frightened families with a private named account
Report an uncertain missing-child account with no proof
options.when: not campaign.var.evidence_brugh_layout and not campaign.var.evidence_gold_threads and not campaign.var.evidence_arthur_double and not campaign.var.evidence_fairy_mirrors and not campaign.var.evidence_parent_suspicion
